principles.title: Ethical conduct
principles.description: Act honestly, be accurate about qualifications and interests, and never pressure anyone for business, money or favours.

principles.title: Equality and respect
principles.description: Treat everyone fairly. No harassment, no discrimination, and no retaliation against anyone who raises a concern.

principles.title: Intellectual property
principles.description: Rights stay with their owner. Share only what you are authorised to, credit creators and agree ownership before joint work.

principles.title: Confidentiality
principles.description: Private discussions, roadmaps and member details stay private, and never go into public AI tools without permission.

principles.title: Conflicts of interest
principles.description: Declare relevant interests in writing, and step back from any decision they could affect.

principles.title: Independent decisions
principles.description: No price fixing, bid rigging or no-poach agreements, and no exchange of competitively sensitive information.

principles.title: Events and representation
principles.description: Respect venues, organisers and each other's choices, and use the Club's name and logo accurately.

principles.title: Fair resolution
principles.description: Concerns are reviewed by someone without a conflict, with the right to respond and to appeal.
